stream.deviation: Android maps refusal/safety stop reasons to a fixed PROVIDER_ERROR end; the desktop emits SafetyBlocked and keeps the stream Done-able.
Android ends with PROVIDER_ERROR and never logs or forwards the upstream error detail.

details.message: 输出因达到模型上下文窗口上限而被截断 (model_context_window_exceeded)

stream.deviation: Android maps the context-window stop reason to STREAM_TRUNCATED instead of a provider_error block.
The desktop wire fallback completes truncated arguments as an executable {}; the Android port fails instead of arming an unverifiable tool call.
A tool_use block without an id never becomes a completed call on Android.
